gates.detail: Explicit pinned source map, bounded known-pattern content scans, descriptor-relative no-follow IO, 15 Node regressions and 7 deterministic Python IO checks passed. This does not replace full content review.

The projected file inventory contains no private Git history, environment/auth data, device/install logs, downloaded library or toolchain/cache outputs. Only selected current source, original/synthetic tests and approved public inputs are copied.

The stage-only GPL-3.0-only grant and scope were approved and prepared; upstream grants/notices and separate CC0/OFL asset boundaries are retained. Private root licensing/visibility are unchanged; binary license inventory remains separate.

The separate runtime-only native projection verifies 8 unchanged Kotlin sources and its 99-path declared build/license closure; public consumer pin omits only the private receipt reference. Clean native rebuilding remains pending.

The exact 650-file, 27,346,772-byte inventory was checked by maintainer and independent scoped reviewers. Hashes/sizes matched; 586 text files were scanned for credential, account, signing/device, home/receipt and media-locator data, and 64 binary files received bounded metadata checks. Matches resolved to synthetic/reserved-domain fixtures or public upstream attribution. Separate generated asset inventories and derivative recipes were checked. No concrete P1/P2 found within this scope; heuristic scans are not proof against obfuscation, and compressed JAR/PDF payloads or media content were not exhaustively inspected. This is not legal or binary clearance.

Clean source projection: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund, lint/typecheck, 736 tests in 51 files and production build passed. Six loopback Chromium/WebKit checks passed: synthetic account/playlist/audio/queue/import/logout, responsive layouts and PWA fallback without account API caching. All 650 pinned source hashes, sizes and modes remained unchanged. Local maintainer attestation, not public CI.
Clean external-JDK21/Xcode rebuild, synthetic interop and candidate-pin review remain pending; the separate source manifest/inventory check is verified.
Capture exact resolved InnerTubeX/Quack and transitive artifacts, source pins, license texts and checksums.
Six new public PNG derivatives are reproduced exactly from included CC0 SVGs with the included recipe and per-file source/hash mapping. Earlier private PNGs are omitted.
Tie a newly built native artifact to this exact source/resource snapshot; no correspondence to an earlier private app is claimed.
Verify complete license/notices and matching corresponding source in each distributed artifact.
Publish and verify a private reporting channel and supported-version policy.

Owner requested open-source GitHub publication and delegated the reviewed preparation and continuation. Authorized scope here is a separate experimental GPL-3.0-only source preview after maintainer review. The private development repository/history, user libraries, credentials, paid services and native binary release are outside this publication.
